name: Filigree
author: Ric
description: A fractal engraved like a guilloché watch dial and lit by slowly orbiting lights in the current theme palette, dense lace lit as a satin sheen instead of one-pixel glints, sinking in an endless, seamless dive into a self-similar point — or, about any other view, a true float64 descent that keeps revealing new structure — with slow colour cycling, plus a studio panel for motion, composition, color, and custom iteration equations.
